hero.title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
hero.description: Jake and Neytiri's family grapples with grief, encountering a new, aggressive Na'vi tribe, the Ash People, who are led by the fiery Varang, as the conflict on Pandora escalates and a new moral focus emerges. The RDA returns to Pandora with a more aggressive military force, while Colonel Miles Quaritch leads a specialized task force dedicated to hunting down Jake Sully. As the family struggles with loss, Jake senses that mortal danger is approaching. Quaritch is still alive and bent on revenge, while a brutal new group of Na'vi marauders who have turned their backs on Eywa emerges. Led by Varang, Pandora's fate is tested on the path of fire and ash.
